InstructionModel.Description: ## Start the DAS Click on the Command button on the right.
## Open the DataCollect Setup window. - IG-XL Main tab - Data Collect group - DataCollect Setup button

## Set the Sublot ID - Go to the Lot Definition tab - Click on "More..." - Set the value for the "Sub Lot" field (5th field from the bottom on the right column) - Click OK - Exit from the DataCollect Setup window by clicking OK
## Execution - Make sure the "Datalog On" button is enabled - Click on "Run" a few times

## Closing the datalog - Open the DataCollect Setup window. - Go to the Summary Report tab - In the "Report" section, click on "Get Final Summary/End Lot" - The DAS window should show a "SubLot End" and the path of the generated data file.
## Check the results - Go to C:\temp and open the generated file - See the data (one section per run and failed tests for each site)
